findings.description: The Lambda environment contains a hardcoded AWS access key ID and secret access key. Environment variables can be exposed through Lambda configuration access, logs, deployment artifacts, or code paths, allowing credential theft and unauthorized AWS access.

The function uses Node.js 12.x, an end-of-life runtime that no longer receives security updates. Known runtime vulnerabilities may remain exploitable in the Lambda execution environment or dependencies that require its outdated ecosystem.
